name: figure
title: Figure
description: An image or a video with its caption, finished at the edge.
use: An image, a video or a drawing in a column of text, on a figure with a figcaption. The caption says why the media is here; its alt says what it shows.

instead.when: A screenshot is shown inside the frame of an application
The media comes with a title and actions
The picture is a person or a team
The reader may want to see the picture large, over the page

classes.name: figure
classes.description: The figure: media over a caption

classes.name: figure-framed
classes.description: The media rests in a tray, 4px in, with the caption inside the frame

classes.name: figure-center
classes.description: A centered, balanced caption, for a figure that stands alone in a column of text

classes.name: figure-media
classes.description: The img, video, svg or any block, with a surface's corner and a hairline ring inside its edge

classes.name: figure-caption
classes.description: The caption, small and muted under the media

properties.name: --figure-ratio
properties.description: The media's aspect ratio, held before it loads; the media then covers that shape. Without it the media keeps its own proportions
